Image quality restoration and clarity enhancement task, strictly adhering to the following constraints:

Absolute fidelity: The subject's pose, identity, facial features, clothing style, composition, background elements, lighting direction, color atmosphere, and overall style must be completely locked. No addition, deletion, replacement, or repainting of any content is permitted.

Restoration goals: Focus solely on high-quality reversal of image degradation. Enhance global resolution and local clarity. Emphasize realistic skin texture (eliminate greasy/oily shine), distinct hair strands, fabric weave patterns, and environmental details (e.g., foliage, wall surfaces, material grains).

Quality requirements: Remove blur, noise, compression artifacts, and edge roughness. Sharpen details while maintaining natural transitions; avoid over-sharpening or HDR-like effects. Restore realistic diffuse reflections and highlight layers under the original lighting, eliminating any plastic-like, waxy, or over-airbrushed appearance.

Prohibited actions: No style transfer, no color shift, no alteration of depth-of-field, no addition of extra lighting effects. Preserve the authentic mood and atmosphere of the original scene.
